info.name: 08 - Gym Person
info.description: Endpoints to manage gym persons (staff and members) including profiles, account linking, and salary payments.

request.description:
### Endpoint Overview

Fetches a paginated list of gym persons (staff and members) with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `UserId` | `int` | Exact | Associated User Account ID (Nullable) |
| `PersonType` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `0` = Staff, `1` = Member, `2` = StaffMember |
| `AccessStatus` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `1` = Active, `2` = Suspended |
| `Name` | `string` | Searchable | Full name of the person |
| `PhoneNumber` | `string` | Searchable | Contact phone |
| `Email` | `string` | Searchable | Contact email (Nullable) |
| `Gender` | `string` | - | Gender (Nullable) |
| `DateOfBirth` | `DateTime` | - | Date of birth (Nullable) |
| `PhotoUrl` | `string` | - | Photo URL (Nullable) |
| `InviteCode` | `Guid` | - | Invitation code for linking user accounts |
| `CreatedOn` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO format creation date |
| `CreatedById` | `int` | Exact | Creator ID |
| `UpdatedAt` | `DateTime` | - | Last update timestamp |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "PersonType": ["1"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "CreatedOn": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym membership with role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches the current authenticated user's GymPerson profile in the active gym context (`/api/GymPerson/me`).

Requires gym membership (`[GymAuthorize]`, any role). SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches a single gym person by ID.

Requires gym membership (`GymAuthorize`, any role). SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Creates a new gym person record. On success, `gymPersonId` and `gymPersonInviteCode` are captured for chaining.

### Request Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `userId` | `int?` | No | Link to an existing registered account |
| `personType` | `Enum (int)` | Yes | `0` = Staff, `1` = Member, `2` = StaffMember |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Full name |
| `phoneNumber` | `string` | Yes | Contact phone |
| `email` | `string?` | No | Contact email |
| `gender` | `string?` | No | Gender |
| `dateOfBirth` | `DateTime?` | No | Date of birth (ISO format) |
| `photoUrl` | `string?` | No | Photo URL |
| `staffProfile` | `object?` | No | Required when `personType` is Staff/StaffMember. Fields: `gymRoleId`, `salary`, `salaryValidFrom`, `salaryValidUntil` |
| `memberProfile` | `object?` | No | Required when `personType` is Member/StaffMember. Fields: `medicalNotes`, `notes` |

### GymRole Enum Values

`0` = Owner, `1` = Manager, `2` = Coach, `3` = Receptionist, `4` = Cleaner, `5` = Other, `10` = Member

### Authorization

Requires gym membership with role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

request.description:
Updates an existing gym person by ID. Supports transitioning between staff/member profiles (see `personType`).

### Request Fields

Same structure as Create. When `personType` is Staff or StaffMember, `staffProfile` fields apply; when Member or StaffMember, `memberProfile` fields apply.

### Authorization

Requires gym membership with role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Links the currently authenticated user account to a gym using an invite code.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID |
| `inviteCode` | `Guid` | Yes | Invite code from the gym person record (`inviteCode`) |

### Behavior

- Requires `[Authorize]` (any authenticated user).
- Returns the linked `GymPersonRDTO`.
- Fails with `400` if the invite code is invalid or already used.

Initiates a salary payment for a staff member (`PersonType` Staff or StaffMember).

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `salaryValidFrom` | `DateTime?` | No | Start of the salary validity period (ISO format) |
| `salaryValidUntil` | `DateTime?` | No | End of the salary validity period (ISO format) |

### Behavior

- Fails with `400` if the person is not Staff/StaffMember or has no staff profile.
- Fails if `salary` is null/zero or the salary validity window is not active.
- Publishes a `SalaryPaidEvent` on success.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Returns `Result<string>` with message "Salary payment initiated successfully."

Renews or extends a member's subscription using a membership plan.

### Request Fields (`RenewMembershipDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `membershipPlanId` | `int` | Yes | Membership plan to renew against |
| `pricePaid` | `decimal` | No | Amount paid (defaults to 0) |
| `discountAmount` | `decimal` | No | Discount applied (defaults to 0) |
| `finalAmount` | `decimal` | No | Final charged amount (defaults to 0) |
| `notes` | `string?` | No | Optional notes (max 500 chars) |

### Behavior

- Fails with `400` if the gym person is not a `Member` or the membership plan does not belong to the gym.
- Returns the updated `GymPersonRDTO`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Suspends or reactivates a gym person's access to the gym.

### Request Fields (`UpdateAccessStatusDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `status` | `Enum (int)` | Yes | `1` = Active, `2` = Suspended |

### Behavior

- Fails with `400` if the gym person already has the requested status.
- Returns the updated `GymPersonRDTO`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Soft-deletes a gym person by ID.

Requires gym membership with role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Allows the currently authenticated user to leave a gym they are registered in.

- Requires `[Authorize]` (any logged-in user).
- The user's `GymPerson` record is soft-deleted.
- Owners cannot leave their gym; they must transfer ownership first.
